name: Gathering Winds
notes:
The max stays 5 stacks at every level. +20% at level 5 matches vanilla Rhythm's top attack speed (ran_rhythm, 0.2).

Every 5 kills by the ranger add a Tailwind stack, up to 5. Each gain, including Tailwind Catch and gains at the cap, refreshes all stacks for 6 seconds. The speed is the tailwind_<level>_<stacks> buff. The duration/refresh change in #77 is source-reviewed; native validation is pending.
summary: Every 5 kills grants a stack of Tailwind for 6s, up to 5 stacks. Gaining Tailwind refreshes all stacks, including at max stacks. Each stack increases your Action Speed (Movement, Skill and Weapon Speed) by 2%.
